SensorReading.title: SensorReading
SensorReading.description: A saved snapshot of live numeric or vector telemetry from a device hardware sensor, GPS, or microphone.

userId.description: Authenticated owner UID matching the parent user document.

sensorId.description: Deterministic identifier of the sensor or module.

values.description: Bounded numeric axis or metric readings (1 to 16 numbers).

unit.description: Measurement unit label (e.g., m/s^2, uT, dBFS, deg).

notes.description: Optional user annotation for the telemetry snapshot.

CameraCaptureRecord.title: CameraCaptureRecord
CameraCaptureRecord.description: Optical and local file metadata for a camera sensor photo capture stored in app-private storage.

userId.description: Authenticated owner UID matching the parent user document.

fileName.description: Local JPEG file name inside app-private camera_captures directory.

localFilePath.description: Absolute path to the captured image file in app-private storage.

lensFacing.description: Camera lens direction used for the capture.

fileSizeBytes.description: Local JPEG file size in bytes.

flashUsed.description: Whether flash illumination was enabled for the capture.

focalLengthMm.description: Optional physical focal length reported by camera characteristics.

caption.description: Optional user caption for the capture.

/users/{userId}/sensor_readings/{reading.description: User-scoped live-synced snapshots of standard hardware, location, and audio sensor readings.

/users/{userId}/camera_captures/{capture.description: User-scoped metadata records for CameraX captures whose binary JPEG files live in app-private local storage.
